policy: Reference and compare sources; do not bulk-copy content until each dataset's license and upstream terms are confirmed. Store source-specific raw snapshots and checksums when a permitted import is performed.

sources.audit: README and docs inspected. One JSON per hero; skill algorithms are hand-authored; only five hero formula sets claimed complete in README. Repository LICENSE file was not found at the expected path during this audit; do not copy code or datasets until license status is confirmed.

Scraper README and source inspected. It posts to a Moonton GMS endpoint and extracts skill metadata and descriptions, not level-by-level damage formulas. Scraper code has MIT license, but repository TERMS.md limits use to educational/research/non-commercial personal use and restricts dataset/assets commercial use. Endpoint access and data redistribution terms remain to be checked.

README inspected. Code is MIT; README explicitly states game data extracted from the Mobile Legends Fandom wiki is CC BY-SA and visual assets belong to Moonton. Sync workflow references Wiki and a stats API. Detailed skill damage formulas are not yet established as a complete independent dataset by this audit.

sources.note: Existing Atlas normalized hero, item and emblem datasets remain reported and are not assumed current for patch 2.2.23.
